product_metadata.title: 18 Pcs Fake Eucalyptus Leaves Stems Bulk Artificial Oval Eucalyptus Leaves Branches in Grey Green for Wedding Holiday Party Greenery Decoration Indoor Floral Vase Bouquets Centerpiece Arrangement
features: Quantity: Package includes 18 Pcs Artificial Eucalyptus Greenery Stems Silk Eucalyptus Leaves Spray. Each faux eucalyptus sprig comes with 9 Pcs eucalyptus leaves on the stem.

Dimension: Each silk eucalyptus leaves spray measures appr. 11.8" tall and the width depends on how you shape the leaf branches. The eucalyptus leaves are appr. 2.5"-2.8" in length and 1.3"-1.9" in width.

Color: The fake eucalyptus leaves are in grey green with clear veins. These faux eucalyptus branches are simple, decorative plants, perfect for complementing your home or wedding greenery decorations.

Material: Silk eucalyptus leaves are hand assembled on the stem so you can pop them right back on if some of them fall. Waterproof plastic stems are wired, so you can easily arrange the artificial eucalyptus spray to create the perfect look.

Whether use to create a nature-inspired floral arrangement and table centerpiece with other artificial flowers, make a farmhouse eucalyptus wreath, add to wedding bouquets and wedding greenery decoration, or just place in a vase for a simple but elegant display, these realistic artificial eucalyptus leaves stems are a great decorative greenery throughout the whole year.
